decisions.reason: Organic sliced ham sits close to the core range and fits the strategic push into organic lines. Slack in a large firm allows carrying it despite 2022 cost pressure and softer organic demand.
Organic Kasseler extends the strategic organic self-service line with little extra resource need. That makes problemistic search unlikely to target it unless sales clearly fall short.
Organic pepper salami uses existing maturation capacity and matches the organic expansion goal, so it likely meets modest aspirations.
The exotic teriyaki aspic is a niche counter specialty and the most likely to miss aspirations as counter demand declines. Still, as a seasonal-style novelty it is probably retained for now.
Fennel salami received its own web page, which signals some commitment. It fits the established salami competence, though as a flavour variant it is vulnerable in range pruning.
A classic liver pâté with veal is a low-risk extension of a core category with dependable demand from traditional consumers.
